title: Fractured Reality | ECHO//100 Episode 65
description:
The memory collapses as Mira extracts the battery, casting our heroes into the void between broken timelines. They confront the source of their existence in a space where reality is merely raw, uncompiled code. Episode 65 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is original fiction generated with AI assistance.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: Obsidian skies fracture, spilling blinding white light across the bedroom floor as reality dissolves.
scenes.caption: The sky shatters
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of the bedroom ceiling fracturing into shards, revealing blinding white void behind, Kavi-Byte in red hoodie and Mira in teal coat looking upward.

scenes.text: Kavi and Mira drift helplessly into a silent, infinite, and empty void of nothingness.
scenes.caption: Falling through void
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte and Mira floating in a vertical white void, the bedroom furniture disintegrating into digital dust behind them.

scenes.text: Null emerges from static, its monstrous purple form vibrating against the pure white geometry.
scenes.caption: Null appears
scenes.image_prompt: Null with red eyes and glitching black-purple silhouette looming over Kavi-Byte in the vast white space.

scenes.text: They stand within the Architect’s source code, the origin point of all universal laws.
scenes.caption: The Architect's source
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte touching a floating holographic grid line in the white space, glowing lines illuminating his red glasses.

scenes.text: The glitching monster screams as its dark armor flickers and dissolves into thin air.
scenes.caption: Null starts dissolving
scenes.image_prompt: Null screaming in pain, its black-purple glitch skin turning transparent, revealing a soft, human glow beneath.

scenes.text: Darkness falls away, revealing a frightened young child huddled amidst the swirling digital static.
scenes.caption: A hidden child
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a small, frightened human child sitting in the white void, the remains of Null’s glitch-cloak falling away.

scenes.text: Mira gasps as the child stands, eyes searching the vast void for a face.
scenes.caption: Child stands up
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking shocked, the small child standing alone in the white space, looking directly at Kavi-Byte.

scenes.text: The boy locks eyes with Kavi, whispering a secret name lost for many long centuries.
scenes.caption: The secret name
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close-up of the child whispering, Kavi-Byte looking stunned, his red hoodie reflecting the stark white light.
